key_concepts: The 5Rs are reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, and repair.
Reducing means using less of something to create smaller amounts of waste.
Reusing means using items again instead of throwing them away.
Recycling means making something new from waste materials.
Repairing means fixing damaged items such as old computers and appliances.

Uncollected waste can cause land, water, and air pollution that harms organisms.
Practicing the 5Rs saves energy and money.
Practicing the 5Rs preserves new materials and conserves raw materials.
Practicing the 5Rs reduces air and water pollution and keeps surroundings clean.
